p11-01.title: Physical Quantities and Vectors
p11-01.concepts: Physics relies on fundamental and derived SI units. Vectors have both magnitude and direction and follow parallelogram and triangle laws of addition. The scalar (dot) product gives work done, while the vector (cross) product determines torque and rotational quantities.
p11-01.bilingual: भौतिक राशिहरूलाई नाप्न SI एकाइ प्रयोग गरिन्छ। सदिश (Vector) राशिमा परिमाण र दिशा दुवै हुन्छ। यसमा त्रिभुज र समानान्तर चतुर्भुजको नियम लागू हुन्छ।

formulas.desc: Resultant magnitude of two vectors inclined at angle θ
Direction angle α of the resultant vector

formulas.math: \vec{A} \cdot \vec{B} = |A||B|\cos\theta = A_x B_x + A_y B_y + A_z B_z

pastPapers.q: State the parallelogram law of vector addition and derive the expression for its resultant magnitude and direction.
Prove that two vectors are perpendicular if their scalar product is zero.

p11-02.title: Kinematics
p11-02.concepts: Kinematics analyzes the motion of objects without considering the forces causing it. Projectile motion is 2D motion under constant gravitational acceleration: horizontal velocity remains constant (ax = 0) while vertical motion changes under gravity (ay = -g).
p11-02.bilingual: प्रक्षेप्य गति (Projectile Motion) मा वस्तुलाई क्षितिजसँग निश्चित कोणमा फ्याँकिन्छ। यसमा तेर्सो वेग सधैं स्थिर रहन्छ भने ठाडो वेग गुरुत्वले गर्दा परिवर्तन हुन्छ।

pastPapers.q: Show that the trajectory of a projectile fired at an angle θ with horizontal is parabolic in nature.
A football is kicked at 40 m/s at 30° to horizontal. Find max height and total time of flight. (Take g = 9.8 m/s²)

ch11-01.title: Foundation and Stoichiometry
ch11-01.concepts: Stoichiometry is the quantitative calculation of reactants and products in chemical reactions based on the Law of Conservation of Mass and Dalton's Atomic Theory. 1 mole of any substance contains Avogadro's constant (6.022 × 10²³) particles and occupies 22.4 L at NTP for ideal gases.
ch11-01.bilingual: स्टोइचियोमेट्रीमा रासायनिक प्रतिक्रियामा भाग लिने पदार्थहरूको मात्रात्मक हिसाब गरिन्छ। १ मोलमा ६.०२२ × १०²३ कणहरू हुन्छन् र ग्यासले NTP मा २२.४ लिटर आयतन ओगट्छ।

formulas.desc: Volume of ideal gas at NTP

pastPapers.q: Define limiting reactant. Calculate the mass of water formed when 4g of H2 reacts with 32g of O2.
Differentiate between empirical formula and molecular formula with an example.

m11-07.title: Limits and Continuity
m11-07.concepts: Limits examine the behavior of a function near a specific point. Indeterminate forms like 0/0 and ∞/∞ are resolved algebraically or through trigonometric limit theorems. A function is continuous at x = a if lim(x->a-) f(x) = lim(x->a+) f(x) = f(a).
m11-07.bilingual: सीमा (Limits) ले फलनको कुनै बिन्दु नजिकको प्रवृत्ति देखाउँछ। x = a मा कुनै फलन निरन्तर (Continuous) हुनका लागि बायाँ सीमा, दायाँ सीमा र त्यस बिन्दुको मान बराबर हुनुपर्छ।

formulas.desc: Condition for Continuity at x = a

pastPapers.q: Evaluate: \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1 - \cos(ax)}{x^2}.
Test the continuity of the function f(x) = |x|/x at x = 0.

cs11-05.title: Introduction to C Programming
cs11-05.concepts: C is a procedural programming language developed by Dennis Ritchie at Bell Labs. Key components include preprocessor directives (#include), main() entry point, data types (int, float, char), formatted I/O (printf, scanf), and arithmetic/logical operators.
cs11-05.bilingual: C प्रोग्रामिङ एक शक्तिशाली प्रक्रियात्मक भाषा हो। यसमा रिएबल, डेटा प्रकार, र अपरेटरहरूको प्रयोग गरेर कम्प्युटरलाई निर्देशन दिइन्छ।

pastPapers.q: Explain the structure of a C program with an annotated example.
Write a C program to input three numbers and find the largest among them using ternary or if-else.

eng11-lit-s01.title: The Selfish Giant by Oscar Wilde
eng11-lit-s01.concepts: A celebrated fairy tale by Oscar Wilde exploring themes of selfishness, compassion, redemption, and spiritual transformation. The Giant bars children from his beautiful garden, plunging it into perpetual winter. When he realizes that love and children bring spring back, his heart softens. A little boy (symbolic of Christ) returns at the end of the Giant's life to invite him to Paradise.
eng11-lit-s01.bilingual: ओस्कार वाइल्डको यो कथाले स्वार्थ र निःस्वार्थ प्रेमको द्वन्द्व देखाउँछ। राक्षसले आफ्नो बगैँचामा बालबालिकालाई खेल्न नदिँदा बगैँचामा हिउँद मात्र रहन्छ। जब उसले आफ्नो गल्ती महसुस गर्छ, प्रेमले बगैँचामा वसन्त फर्किन्छ।
themes: Love and Compassion as Life-Giving Forces
Redemption and Christian Allegory of Forgiveness

characters.name: The Selfish Giant
characters.traits: Initially arrogant, possessive, and hostile; transforms into a loving, humble protector of children.

characters.name: The Little Boy
characters.traits: A tiny weeping child unable to reach tree branches; Christ-figure who ultimately welcomes the Giant into his garden (Heaven).

characters.name: The Children
characters.traits: Innocent bringers of spring, joy, birdsong, and blossoms.

literary_devices.example: Winter, Snow, Frost, North Wind, and Hail are personified as uninvited destructive guests in the garden.
Spring symbolizes life, joy, and love; Winter symbolizes cold emotional isolation and selfishness.
The little boy with wounds of two nails on hands and feet represents Jesus Christ.

grammar_vocab.meaning: People who enter someone's land or property without permission.
Formally taken to court or punished by legal action.
A small brown and grey European songbird.

grammar_vocab.example: 'I have many beautiful flowers,' he said, 'but the children are the most beautiful flowers of all.'

pastPapers.q: How does the author show that selfishness leads to misery while compassion brings joy in 'The Selfish Giant'?
pastPapers.ans: Oscar Wilde uses the changing seasons as a powerful metaphor to contrast selfishness and compassion. When the Giant selfishly builds a high wall around his garden and puts up a notice 'TRESPASSERS WILL BE PROSECUTED', Spring refuses to visit. Instead, the garden is trapped in perpetual Winter, with Frost, Snow, North Wind, and Hail destroying the landscape. The moment the Giant allows children back, trees blossom, birds sing, and Spring instantly returns. This illustrates that selfish isolation leads to spiritual decay, whereas generosity and love invite joy and renewal.

pastPapers.q: Who was the little boy and why was the Giant moved to tears when he met him?
pastPapers.ans: The little boy was a manifestation of Jesus Christ. The Giant was deeply moved when he saw the boy too small to climb the tree, and later when the boy returned with the wounds of love (stigmata) to take the Giant to his heavenly garden.

eng11-lit-p01.title: Corona Says by Vishnu S. Rai
eng11-lit-p01.concepts: A thought-provoking modern poem by Nepalese poet Vishnu S. Rai written in the voice of the COVID-19 pandemic. The virus addresses humanity directly, claiming it was not an enemy but a consequence of human hubris, environmental destruction, deforestation, endless wars, and vanity. It urges humans to reflect on their fragile position in the cosmos and respect Mother Earth.
eng11-lit-p01.bilingual: विष्णु एस. राईको यो कविता कोरोना भाइरसको दृष्टिकोणबाट लेखिएको हो। भाइरसले मानिसलाई प्रकृतिको दोहन, युद्ध, र घमण्ड त्याग्न चेतावनी दिँदै मानव अस्तित्वको नश्वरता र प्रकृतिको श्रेष्ठता सम्झाउँछ।
themes: Futility of Wars and Materialistic Pride

literary_devices.example: The virus speaks as a conscious moral judge examining human actions.
Why do you blame me when you yourself have murdered millions in wars and destroyed your own mother Earth?
Humans consider themselves masters of the earth, yet are humbled into confinement by an invisible microscopic organism.

pastPapers.q: What moral message does the speaker convey to human beings in the poem 'Corona Says'?
pastPapers.ans: In 'Corona Says', Vishnu S. Rai conveys an urgent ecological and moral message. The speaker (the virus) cautions humans against their destructive arrogance, greed, and exploitation of nature. The poet reminds humans that trees, rivers, birds, and animals have an equal right to exist on Earth. Rather than being an unjustified killer, the virus presents itself as a natural warning shot to allow the poisoned atmosphere, choked skies, and scorched forests to breathe and recover from human cruelty.

pastPapers.q: Why does Corona say 'I have not come of my own free will'?
pastPapers.ans: Corona asserts that it was invited by human actions—specifically the ruthless destruction of natural habitats, pollution of the earth, and moral decay.

nep11-p01.title: पाठ १: वीर पुर्खा (कविता - वासुदेव त्रिपाठी)
nep11-p01.concepts: प्रा. डा. वासुदेव त्रिपाठीद्वारा रचित 'वीर पुर्खा' कविता राष्ट्रभक्ति र नेपाली पुर्खाहरूको वीरताको गौरवगाथा हो। यस कवितामा हाम्रा पुर्खाहरूले टिस्टादेखि काँगडासम्म र गङ्गादेखि सतलजसम्म नेपालको सीमा विस्तार गर्दा देखाएको असाधारण बहादुरी, आँधीहुरी र हिमाललाई समेत जितेको अदम्य साहसको प्रशंसा गरिएको छ।
nep11-p01.bilingual: यो कविता नेपाली पुर्खाहरूको वीरता, स्वाभिमान र बलिदानको गाथा हो। पुर्खाले रगत पसिना बगाएर अखण्ड नेपाल निर्माण गरेको इतिहास सम्झाउँदै भावी पुस्तालाई देशको स्वाधीनता जोगाउन प्रेरित गर्छ।
themes: पुर्खाको वीरता र बलिदानी इतिहासको गौरवगान

grammar_vocab.meaning: बहुमूल्य वस्तु वा धन राख्ने काठ वा धातुको बाकस
सन् १८१६ को नेपाल-अंग्रेज सन्धि भएको ऐतिहासिक स्थान

pastPapers.q: 'वीर पुर्खा' कविताको मूल भाव वा सन्देश आफ्नै शब्दमा स्पष्ट गर्नुहोस्।
pastPapers.ans: प्रा. डा. वासुदेव त्रिपाठीद्वारा रचित 'वीर पुर्खा' कविता एक सशक्त राष्ट्रभक्तिपूर्ण कविता हो। यस कविताको मूल भाव हाम्रा पुर्खाहरूको अदम्य आँट, शौर्य र बलिदानप्रति गौरव प्रकट गर्नु हो। हाम्रा पुर्खाहरूले हिमालको चिसो, जङ्गलको विकटता र विदेशी शत्रुको आक्रमणको पर्वाह नगरी टिस्टादेखि काँगडासम्म मातृभूमिको सीमा विस्तार गरे। उनीहरूको पदचापले पहाड, गङ्गा र आकाशलाई समेत थर्काएको थियो। अतः पुर्खाहरूको बलिदानबाट निर्माण भएको यस स्वाधीन नेपाललाई अक्षुण्ण राख्नु र उनीहरूको स्वाभिमानलाई जीवित राख्नु नै आजका प्रत्येक नेपालीको मुख्य कर्तव्य हो भन्ने सन्देश कविताले दिएको छ।

pastPapers.q: पुर्खालाई 'आँधीका सन्तान' किन भनिएको हो?
pastPapers.ans: पुर्खाहरू कुनै पनि विघ्नबाधा र प्राकृतिक प्रतिकूलतासँग नडराई आँधीझैँ बेगले अगाडि बढेर असम्भवलाई सम्भव बनाउन सक्ने साहसी भएकाले उनीहरूलाई 'आँधीका सन्तान' भनिएको हो।

nep11-p02.title: पाठ २: गाउँको माया (कथा - इस्माली)
nep11-p02.concepts: प्रगतिवादी कथाकार इस्मालीद्वारा रचित 'गाउँको माया' कथामा ग्रामीण नेपाली समाजको श्रमजीवी वर्गको सङ्घर्ष, गरिबी, र मानवीय आत्मीयताको सजीव चित्रण गरिएको छ। गाउँ छोडेर सहर वा विदेशिन बाध्य हुने विपन्न युवाहरूको मानसिक पीडा र आफ्नै माटोप्रतिको अगाध मायालाई कथाले उजागर गरेको छ।
nep11-p02.bilingual: यो कथाले गरिबी, शोषण र अभावका बाबजुद गाउँले जीवनमा पाइने निःस्वार्थ माया, आत्मीयता र श्रमप्रतिको सम्मानलाई मार्मिक ढङ्गले प्रस्तुत गर्दछ।
themes: गाउँले परिवेश र माटोप्रतिको अगाध स्नेह
गरिबी, बेरोजगारी र विस्थापनको सामाजिक समस्या
श्रमजीवी वर्गको स्वाभिमान र आपसी सहयोग

characters.name: रामबहादुर
characters.traits: परिश्रमी, स्वाभिमानी, गाउँको माटोलाई प्राणभन्दा प्यारो ठान्ने श्रमजीवी पात्र।

characters.name: सुन्तली
characters.traits: सहनशील, घरायसी जिम्मेवारी सम्हाल्ने र मायालु स्वभावकी नारी पात्र।

grammar_vocab.example: दुर् + गन्ध = दुर्गन्ध (उपसर्ग); माया + आलु = मायालु (प्रत्यय)

pastPapers.q: 'गाउँको माया' कथाले नेपाली समाजको कुन यथार्थलाई उजागर गरेको छ?
pastPapers.ans: 'गाउँको माया' कथाले आधुनिक नेपाली समाजको तीतो यथार्थलाई प्रस्तुत गरेको छ। एकातिर ग्रामीण क्षेत्रमा पर्याप्त रोजगारी र सुविधाहरू नहुँदा युवा पुस्ता गाउँ छोड्न बाध्य छ भने अर्कातिर गाउँको प्राकृतिक सुन्दरता, निःस्वार्थ सम्बन्ध र माटोको सुगन्धले उनीहरूलाई सधैं आकर्षित गरिरहन्छ। कथाले देखाउँछ कि भौतिक विकास नभए पनि गाउँमा पाइने भावनात्मक सुख सहरको कोलाहलमा पाइँदैन। श्रमको सम्मान र गाउँको संरक्षण नै दिगो राष्ट्रिय विकासको आधार हो भन्ने यथार्थ कथाले बोकेको छ।

eng12-lit-s01.title: Neighbours by Tim Winton
eng12-lit-s01.concepts: An Australian short story by Tim Winton exploring multiculturalism, immigration, prejudice, and community solidarity. A newly married Australian couple moves into a multicultural suburb surrounded by European immigrants (Macedonians, Italians, Greeks). Initially disgusted by their strange habits and loud noises, the couple slowly discovers their neighbours' boundless generosity, especially when they help build a garden and celebrate the birth of their baby boy.
eng12-lit-s01.bilingual: टिम विन्टनको यो कथाले बहुसांस्कृतिक समाजमा सुरुमा हुने शङ्का र पूर्वाग्रह कसरी आपसी सहयोग, सद्भाव र नयाँ बच्चाको जन्मसँगै आत्मीयतामा परिणत हुन्छ भन्ने देखाउँछ।
themes: Birth of New Life as a Universal Catalyst for Harmony

characters.name: The Young Man
characters.traits: Intellectual writing a thesis on the 20th-century novel; initially proud and prejudiced, eventually weeps with gratitude for human connection.

characters.name: The Young Woman
characters.traits: Works in a hospital; independent; embraced by immigrant women during pregnancy and childbirth.

characters.name: The Polish and Macedonian Neighbours
characters.traits: Loud, energetic immigrants who demonstrate selfless neighbourly generosity by giving timber, garlic cloves, advice, and baby gifts.

literary_devices.example: The couple looked down on their immigrant neighbours, yet those same neighbours became their greatest source of strength and support.
The vegetable garden and the newborn baby symbolize growth, new beginnings, and communal unity.

pastPapers.q: Explain the transformation in the young couple's attitude towards their neighbours in the story 'Neighbours'.
pastPapers.ans: Initially, the young Australian couple harboured deep prejudice against their immigrant neighbours. They found their loud shouting, strange cooking, and backyard slaughtering disgusting and invasive. However, the turning point occurs in autumn when the neighbours spontaneously offer help with fencing, mulching, and planting garlic. During the woman's pregnancy, the community rallies with care—offering chocolates, advice, and knitted baby garments. When their child is born, the entire neighbourhood rejoices. The young man realizes that genuine human connection transcends language barriers, leading him to weep with humility and joy.

pastPapers.q: What does the author mean by 'The twentieth-century novel had not prepared him for this'?
pastPapers.ans: The young man's academic study of modern novels taught him about cynicism, individual alienation, and detachment, but it had not prepared him for the raw, miraculous power of real human community, empathy, and collective joy.

nep12-p01.title: पाठ १: आमाको सपना (कविता - गोपालप्रसाद रिमाल)
nep12-p01.concepts: युगकवि गोपालप्रसाद रिमालद्वारा रचित 'आमाको सपना' नेपाली साहित्यको एक क्रान्तिकारी गद्य कविता हो। यसमा आमा (मातृभूमि/जनता) ले आफ्नो छोरा (भावी पुस्ता/क्रान्तिकारी योद्धा) सँग संवाद गर्दै नेपालमा एक दिन निरङ्कुशता र अन्धकार चिरेर मुक्ति, समानता र प्रजातन्त्रको न्यानो घाम लिएर क्रान्तिवीर आउने आशावादी सपना व्यक्त गरेकी छिन्।
nep12-p01.bilingual: गोपालप्रसाद रिमालको यो कविता नेपाली प्रजातान्त्रिक आन्दोलनको विगुल हो। आमाले छोरालाई देशमा अन्याय र दमनको अन्त्य गरी उज्यालो युग ल्याउने क्रान्तिको आगमन अवश्य हुने विश्वास दिलाउँछिन्।
themes: प्रजातान्त्रिक चेतना र सामाजिक क्रान्तिको उद्घोष
अन्याय र शोषण विरुद्ध सङ्घर्षको अनिवार्यता

pastPapers.q: 'आमाको सपना' कविताको मूल सन्देश के हो? व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्।
pastPapers.ans: युगकवि गोपालप्रसाद रिमालको 'आमाको सपना' कविता परिवर्तन, विद्रोह र आशावादले ओतप्रोत प्रगतिशील कविता हो। यस कवितामा 'आमा' लाई मातृभूमि नेपाल र 'छोरा' लाई भावी क्रान्तिकारी पुस्ताका रूपमा प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ। तत्कालीन जहानियाँ राणा शासनको दमन र अन्यायपूर्ण अवस्थामा पनि आमा निराश हुन्नन्। उनी आफ्नो छोरालाई धैर्य धारण गर्न भन्दै एक दिन अन्यायको पर्खाल भत्काएर उज्यालो बिहानी ल्याउने 'युगनायक' को जन्म अवश्य हुने उद्घोष गर्छिन्। अतः निरङ्कुशताको अन्त्य भई जनताले स्वतन्त्रता, न्याय र आत्मसम्मान पाउने दिन अवश्य आउँछ भन्ने क्रान्तिकारी सन्देश यस कविताले दिएको छ।

pastPapers.q: कवितामा आमाले छोरालाई कसरी सान्त्वना दिएकी छिन्?
pastPapers.ans: आमाले छोरालाई आफू आएपछि उसले भोगेका सबै पीडा र आँसुहरू बिर्सने गरी न्याय र सुखको उज्यालो युग आउनेछ भन्दै सान्त्वना दिएकी छिन्।
